name: scholar-workflow
description: Project-centered research context, readable knowledge and reproducible experiment records using Zotero, Obsidian, Notion and native tools.

interface.shortDescription: Research projects, knowledge, and experiment records
interface.longDescription: Organize project code, papers, knowledge notes and experiment results without copying their authoritative content. Maintain readable paper analyses and reproducible project records while using existing editors and native tools.
defaultPrompt: Survey a research topic and build a literature map.
Find a paper, check my Zotero library, and import it safely.
Analyze a saved paper and update my research notes.
Initialize a new project with the standard Git-managed skeleton.
